sections.title: Booking & Payment
items: All bookings are confirmed on a first-come, first-served basis and subject to availability upon receipt of full payment.
A minimum of three (3) certified divers is required to operate a trip.
Full payment is required at the time of booking to secure the Locked-in Date.

sections.title: Package Inclusions
items: Each day trip includes three (3) scuba dives per boat.
Boat transfers are included in the dive package price.
A gratuity fee of RM5 per person per day is applicable and charged separately.

children: 50% of the total package price will be forfeited for cancellations made more than fourteen (14) days prior to the Locked-in Date.
100% of the total package price will be forfeited for cancellations made within fourteen (14) days, including no-shows.

items.text: No refunds will be provided for:
children: Missed dives
Incomplete dive sessions
Late arrivals
Voluntary withdrawal from any dive activity

sections.title: Dive Operations
items: Divers must arrive at the designated jetty by 6:45 AM for registration and safety briefing.
Late arrivals may result in automatic cancellation without refund to ensure operational safety and schedule integrity.
All participants under the same booking or package must participate on the same scheduled dive day.

sections.title: Safety, Health & Certification
items: All divers must hold a valid and recognised scuba diving certification issued by an internationally recognised training agency.
Divers are required to truthfully declare their medical condition and sign a Liability Release & Assumption of Risk Form prior to participation.
The dive operator reserves the right to deny participation to any diver deemed medically unfit, uncertified, or unsafe to dive, without refund.

sections.title: Weather, Sea & Force Majeure
items: Dive operations are subject to weather conditions, sea state, marine park regulations, and safety considerations.
The operator reserves the right to reschedule, modify dive sites, or cancel trips due to adverse conditions or force majeure events, in compliance with marine safety standards.

sections.title: Compliance & Management Rights
items: By purchasing or redeeming any package, participants acknowledge and agree to comply with all safety, operational, and regulatory requirements prescribed by the operator.
Management reserves the absolute right to amend, vary, or withdraw these Terms & Conditions at any time without prior notice.

sections.title: 预订与付款
items: 所有预订将以先到先得方式确认，并须在收到全额付款后视供应情况而定。
每趟行程至少需三（3）名持有有效认证的潜水员方可成行。
须于预订时完成全额付款，以锁定已确认的行程日期。

sections.title: 配套包含项目
items: 每趟一日行程每艘船包含三（3）次水肺潜水。
潜水配套价格已包含船只接送服务。
每日每人将另行收取 RM5 的服务小费。

children: 若于锁定日期十四（14）天前取消行程，将没收配套总价的 50%。
若于锁定日期十四（14）天内取消行程（包括爽约），将没收配套总价的 100%。

sections.title: 潜水行程安排
items: 潜水员须于上午 6:45 前抵达指定码头，以进行登记及安全简报。
为确保行程安全及运作顺畅，迟到者可能被视为自动取消，且不予退款。
同一预订或配套下的所有参与者，必须于同一预定日期参加潜水活动。

sections.title: 安全、健康与认证
items: 所有潜水员必须持有由国际认可培训机构所颁发的有效水肺潜水认证。
潜水员须如实申报个人健康状况，并于参与前签署《免责与风险承担声明书》。
如潜水员被认定为健康不适、未持有效认证或存在安全风险，营运方有权拒绝其参与，且不予退款。

sections.title: 天气、海况与不可抗力
items: 潜水行程将视天气状况、海况、海洋公园规定及安全考量而定。
如遇恶劣天气或不可抗力事件，营运方有权根据海事安全标准重新安排、调整潜点或取消行程。

sections.title: 合规与管理权利
items: 凡购买或使用任何配套，即表示参与者同意遵守营运方所制定的所有安全、操作及监管规定。
管理层保留在无需事先通知的情况下，随时修订、更改或撤回本条款与细则的绝对权利。

items: Each day trip includes two (2) guided snorkelling sessions at designated snorkelling sites.
